title: Sprint Review Gone Wrong
goal: Communicate a sprint delay to Mark Kim professionally, explain the root cause, provide a recovery plan, and manage his expectations without losing his trust.
context_doc:
SPRINT 12 STATUS REPORT

Original deadline: End of this week (Friday)
Current completion: 60%
Remaining tasks: 4 features, 2 bug fixes

Root causes of delay:
- Sarah's team discovered a critical API compatibility issue (3 days lost)
- New compliance requirement added mid-sprint by legal team
- One developer sick for 4 days

Proposed new timeline: +8 business days
Risk if we don't extend: shipping broken features to enterprise clients

KPIs at risk: Q4 launch target, client satisfaction score
hint: Start with the bad news clearly, then explain why (root causes), then offer your recovery plan with specific dates. Don't apologize too much — be professional and solution-focused.
opening_message: I've been looking at the sprint dashboard and the numbers don't look good. Explain what's happening and what you're doing about it.
